title: Problem Solver
text: Problem Solver. I found myself completely frustrated with my pots & pans cabinet. No matter how much I organized, the lids created an unorganized mess after one access to the cabinet. I set this up - very quick and easy to use - and voila, no more lids in the way. Absolutely love it!

product_metadata.title: YouCopia StoreMore Adjustable Pot Lid Organizer, One Size, White
features: Organize your pot and pan lids (not included) in the lower cabinet or pantry to easily find and retrieve one lid at a time
Features 7 adjustable dividers to perfectly fit lids so they remain upright and separate; Additional StoreMore Lid Holder Wire Dividers sold separately (ASIN B01M0AD4ZY)
Strong coated steel wires fit securely into base; will NOT pop out or scratch lids
Soft non-slip feet hold everything in place inside the cabinet and round lids stay centered in base
No installation required; Measures 7-1/2" D x 11-1/2" W x 5" H; Made from durable ABS plastic and coated steel wires; Imported; White

details.Material: Alloy Steel, Plastic, Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene
